instruction: For each sender, tally the number of emails they have in the Thunderbird daily folder, then generate a LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet called 'sender_count.xlsx' on the Desktop listing sender name and email count in two columns.

metadata.explanation: Task requires counting emails per sender in the daily folder and creating a two-column spreadsheet. Verified by analyzing all 9 emails: HKU Bulk Email Delivery System (4), eNotices System (4), Media Team CPAO (1). Custom getter extracts sender counts from Excel, custom metric validates all three senders have correct counts.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Each sender contributes equally to the score: HKU Bulk Email Delivery System (0.33), eNotices System (0.33), Media Team CPAO (0.34). Full credit given only if count matches exactly.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts sender counts from Excel file at /home/user/Desktop/sender_count.xlsx
Getter properly parses two-column format (sender name in column A, count in column B) with header detection
Metric correctly validates all three expected senders with exact count matching
Postconfig appropriately saves the file before verification
Partial credit scoring is fair and proportional (each sender contributes 1/3 of total score)
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns Dict[str, int], metric expects Dict[str, int] via expected.get('sender_counts')
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider penalizing extra senders not in the expected list (currently only checks if expected senders exist with correct counts)
Case-sensitive sender name matching may cause false negatives if there are minor variations in sender names
